rendered.overview: This non-black deck plays [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] as a bending engine: every waterbend, earthbend, firebend, or airbend effect draws a card, and performing all four in a turn transforms him into a repeating draw-and-damage payoff. Allies such as [[Aang, the Last Airbender]], [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]], and [[Katara, Water Tribe's Hope]] trigger those bending types while growing the board with tokens and counters. As a backup, [[Aang, the Last Airbender]], [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]], and [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] can loop for infinite creature tokens.

weaknesses: Moderate: Only [[Origin of Metalbending]] can destroy an opposing artifact or enchantment, leaving little backup removal.
Moderate: With just two interaction spells and no mass removal, the deck struggles to stop a fast combo in time.
Moderate: Removing [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] cuts off the deck's main draw and damage engine.

plans.primary: The deck casts [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] and chains bending effects to draw cards and transform him into a damage-dealing payoff.
backups: As a backup, it assembles [[Aang, the Last Airbender]], [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]], and [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] for an infinite loop of creature tokens.
It can also grind out value by pumping and protecting its Allies with waterbend and earthbend effects from cards like [[Katara, Water Tribe's Hope]] and [[Iroh, Dragon of the West]].

strategy.text: Cast [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] around turn 4 to start drawing from bending triggers.
Airbend permanents with [[Aang, the Last Airbender]] and [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] to trigger draws and make tokens.
Waterbend with [[Katara, Water Tribe's Hope]] and earthbend lands to grow your team each turn.
Transforming [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] cuts spell costs and deals repeated upkeep damage.
Backup: [[Aang, the Last Airbender]], [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]], and [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] combo for infinite tokens.

keep.text: [[Iroh, Dragon of the West]] into two lands ramps toward bending turns early.
[[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] with any two lands sets up airbending plus tokens.

sendBack.text: Single-color hands struggle to cast four-color Lessons like [[Water Whip]].
Hands with no early plays stall before reaching [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] mana.

tips.text: [[Aang, the Last Airbender]] exiles a permanent, then casting it from exile while [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] is out makes an Ally token.
[[Uncle Iroh]] lowers the cost of Lesson spells, helping you trigger [[Guru Pathik]]'s counter ability more often.
Tokens from [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] can tap to help pay the waterbend cost on [[Katara, Water Tribe's Hope]].

assessment.line: Only [[Origin of Metalbending]] can destroy an opposing artifact or enchantment, leaving little backup removal.
With just two interaction spells and no mass removal, the deck struggles to stop a fast combo in time.
Removing [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] cuts off the deck's main draw and damage engine.
The deck wins mainly through combat damage, leaving it vulnerable to a pillowfort effect like [[Ghostly Prison]].
Removing [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] before it resolves stops the infinite token loop with [[Aang, the Last Airbender]].
Tapped lands like [[Sun-Blessed Peak]] and [[Hinterland Harbor]] can slow this four-color manabase.
